title: Product transformation
statementMd:
Consider an array $*A*$ with $*N*$ elements, all being the same integer $*a*$.

Define the product transformation as a simultaneous update $*A*_{*i*} = *A*_{*i*}·*A*_{*i* + 1}$, that is multiplying each element to the element right to it for ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bab7e22f732dff71f7d64d3ebfc08bb437dcd67f.png), with the last number $*A*_{*N*}$ remaining the same. For example, if we start with an array $*A*$ with $*a* = 2$ and $*N* = 4$, then after one product transformation $*A* = [4,  4,  4,  2]$, and after two product transformations $*A* = [16,  16,  8,  2]$.

Your simple task is to calculate the array $*A*$ after $*M*$ product transformations. Since the numbers can get quite big you should output them modulo $*Q*$.

## Input

The first and only line of input contains four integers $*N*$, $*M*$, $*a*$, $*Q*$ ($7 ≤ *Q* ≤ 10^{9} + 123$, $2 ≤ *a* ≤ 10^{6} + 123$, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2ac3dce719aaa3202862fcb75cce57e5994e48b1.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9e311783e65b119bb1fd35c8a4f2a4d6933d358d.png) is prime), where ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9e311783e65b119bb1fd35c8a4f2a4d6933d358d.png) is the multiplicative order of the integer $*a*$ modulo $*Q*$, see notes for definition.

## Output

You should output the array $*A*$ from left to right.

## Note

The multiplicative order of a number $*a*$ modulo $*Q*$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/38b13c1f6db75ae72784f8602e8230429b26cf2a.png), is the smallest natural number $*x*$ such that $*a*^{*x*} *mod* *Q* = 1$. For example, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/64b53b8160eddc004a5b65223bf29dd636bb1832.png).
statementZhMd:
考虑一个包含 $*N*$ 个元素的数组 $*A*$，其中所有元素都为同一个整数 $*a*$。

定义乘积变换为一次同步更新：$*A*_{*i*} = *A*_{*i*}·*A*_{*i* + 1}$，即将每个元素乘以它右侧的元素（![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bab7e22f732dff71f7d64d3ebfc08bb437dcd67f.png)），而最后一个数 $*A*_{*N*}$ 保持不变。例如，若初始数组 $*A*$ 中 $*a* = 2$ 且 $*N* = 4$，则进行一次乘积变换后，$*A* = [4,  4,  4,  2]$；进行两次乘积变换后，$*A* = [16,  16,  8,  2]$。

你的任务是计算进行 $*M*$ 次乘积变换后的数组 $*A*$。由于数值可能变得非常大，请输出它们对 $*Q*$ 取模后的结果。

## 输入格式

输入仅一行，包含四个整数 $*N*$、$*M*$、$*a*$、$*Q*$（$7 ≤ *Q* ≤ 10^{9} + 123$、$2 ≤ *a* ≤ 10^{6} + 123$、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2ac3dce719aaa3202862fcb75cce57e5994e48b1.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9e311783e65b119bb1fd35c8a4f2a4d6933d358d.png) 为素数），其中 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9e311783e65b119bb1fd35c8a4f2a4d6933d358d.png) 是整数 $*a*$ 模 $*Q*$ 的乘法阶，定义见说明。

## 输出格式

从左到右输出数组 $*A*$。

## 说明

一个数 $*a*$ 模 $*Q*$ 的乘法阶 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/38b13c1f6db75ae72784f8602e8230429b26cf2a.png)，是满足 $*a*^{*x*} *mod* *Q* = 1$ 的最小自然数 $*x*$。例如，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/64b53b8160eddc004a5b65223bf29dd636bb1832.png)。
